excerpt.zh: [gateway_system.GetName]星系中为建造星门而准备的深空建造基址已经准备就绪。一旦我们的必要资源准备完毕，星门的正式建造随时都可以动工。
excerpt.en: The deep space construction site for the planned Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system is now in place. Once we have the necessary resources, construction of the actual Gateway may commence at any time.
